description: 48 sheet illuminated advertising panel to 1 no. 48 sheet digital advertising display unit, to flank wall of 135 Lower Clapton Road
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-c6250ff3-7fff-cfa2-be06-765dce391082"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The advertisement, by reason of its size,  scale, location and digital display, would have a significant </span></span><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 14.6667px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">negative impact on the operation of transport infrastructure, affecting </span></font><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">highway safety. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies T2 (Healthy Streets), and T4 (Assessing and Mitigating Transport Impacts) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP41 (Liveable Neighbourhoods) and LP43 (Transport and Development) of Hackney's Local Development Plan (2020).</span></p>

<p><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed development, by reason of its detailed design, display, scale, and siting, results in unnecessary clutter in the street scene and has an </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; vertical-align: baseline;">unacceptable impact upon the visual amenities of the surrounding area. Furthermore, the proposal fails to </span><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 14.6667px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">conserve or enhance and reveal the significance of the locally listed building and its setting. </span></font><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; vertical-align: baseline;">As such, the proposal is contrary to policies PP1 (Public Realm), LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), LP4 (Non-Designated Heritage Assets), and LP7 (Advertisements) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020), and policies D4 (Delivering good design) and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021).&nbsp;</span></p>
